name: array-test-774a6d4802/array-cyclic-p1-p.bal
spec_references: Module-level declarations: Class definition; Supports `object-field`, `method-defn` and `object-type-inclusion` members
reason: The @panic assertion depends on unbounded mutually recursive object initialization (P1.init constructs Q1, whose init constructs P1) terminating with a runtime panic. Class definitions and new expressions are supported, but subset10 does not cover stack-exhaustion detection or its conversion into a panic; support for an explicit panic statement does not establish that behavior.
unsupported_constructs: Runtime stack-exhaustion panic from indefinitely recursive object initialization
test_design_notes: The recursive new on the right side of arr[3] = new is evaluated before the array assignment completes; this case cannot independently establish cyclic array filler behavior.
